newsitem.title: USA: Boston Chicken to convert NY loan to equity.
newsitem.headline: Boston Chicken to convert NY loan to equity.

text.p: Boston Chicken Inc said Tuesday it planned to convert its loan to BC New York, LLC into a majority equity interest in the New York-based area developer of Boston Market stores.
The transaction, expected to close in the next several weeks, would increase Boston Chicken's company-store base by 118 stores, bringing the total to 223 company-owned stores.

As part of the transaction, Boston Chicken also plans to purchase 40 percent of the minority equity interest in BC New York, resulting in Boston Chicken owning approximately 84 percent of the New York metropolitan area developer.
The remaining minority interest will be retained by BC New York's management and its private equity investors.
Boston Chicken makes loans, which can later be converted into majority equity, to its area developers as part of its rapid expansion strategy.
The company says these convertible loans allow area developers to open stores and create Boston Market brand awareness more quickly than with a traditional franchising structure.
New York conversion will reduce Boston Chicken's outstanding loans to area developers by $80 million.

As part of the transaction, the management and private equity investors of BC New York will form a new Boston Market area developer, called BC Tri-States, which will acquire rights from BC New York to develop approximately 260 more stores in the New York metropolitan area.
